newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares aiming for record levels again.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares aiming for record levels again.

text.p: Belgian shares, relieved after the FOMC meeting did not yield any rate hike, were gearing up on Wednesday for a short-term assault on the Bel-20 index record, dealers said.
"(The FOMC decision) may well trigger another attack on the record," one trader said.
At 0900 GMT, the Bel-20 index was up 0.80 percent, or 17.92 points, at 2,245.92, 26 points short of its all time high set on May 6.
A firmer dollar and solid bond markets provided additional support.
Cement maker CBR and non-ferrous metals firm Union Miniere bucked the Bel-20 trend, dipping five and 10 francs respectively to 3,490 and 2,870 francs.
Holding company Gevaert was among the leading gainers with a 2.6 percent jump to 3,000 francs despite a downgrade to hold from buy by Generale Bank in its daily equity focus.
Market leaders in value terms were banks BBL and Generale Bank, which both outperformed the market with a 1.0 and 0.9 percent gain respectively.
